requiredBehaviors.behavior: create core, adjacent and wildcard talent pools
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The strategy model explicitly separates core target companies, adjacent talent pools and wildcard hypotheses.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: derive role families from required capabilities rather than exact title matching
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow requires role-family derivation from capability patterns and explicitly warns against exact-title-only search.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: document explicit search hypotheses with linked criteria
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Each search hypothesis must include rationale and links to relevant role criteria.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep concrete candidate discovery separate from person evaluation
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill boundary treats search-space design and discovery separately from professional-person-research and role-capability mapping.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: rank candidates inside the search strategy
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Candidate ranking is outside the search-strategy scope.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat company prestige as evidence of role fit
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Target-company relevance must be evidence-backed or explicitly hypothetical; prestige is not accepted as fit evidence.
